te: Roman emperor Claudius dies from poisoning under mysterious circumstances. He is succeeded by his adopted son Nero, rat…
dz: 罗马皇帝克劳迪乌斯在神秘的情况下死于中毒. 他由养子尼禄接任,而不是由与梅萨利纳同属的不列颠尼克斯接任.
de: Roman emperor Claudius dies from poisoning under mysterious circumstances. He is succeeded by his adopted son Nero, rather than by Britannicus, his son with Messalina.
